## Latest XKCD

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# Read the data generated by the targets pipeline
# The data file is located at the project root's data/ directory
# When rendering from inst/qmd/, we need to go up levels or assume the build process moves files.
# However, in the standard workflow, data is in ../../data/xkcd.json relative to inst/qmd?
# No, typically Quarto projects have a root.
# Let's assume we run quarto render from the project root (as done in CI).
# But the file is in 'inst/qmd/xkcd.qmd'.
# The CI runs: nix-shell default.nix --run "quarto render"
# Quarto render will process _quarto.yml.
# If _quarto.yml is in the root, and render targets inst/qmd/xkcd.qmd.
# The working directory during execution of chunks is usually the directory of the qmd file.
# So we need to look at ../../data/xkcd.json.

data_path <- "../../data/xkcd.json"
if (!file.exists(data_path)) {
  # Fallback if running from root or if path differs
  data_path <- "data/xkcd.json" 
}

if (file.exists(data_path)) {
  data <- jsonlite::read_json(data_path)
  
  # Create HTML output
  html_content <- sprintf(
    '
    <div class="card">
      <div class="card-header">%s</div>
      <div style="text-align: center; padding: 20px;">
        <a href="%s" target="_blank" title="%s">
          <img src="%s" title="%s" style="max-width: 100%%; height: auto; cursor: pointer;">
        </a>
      </div>
      <div class="card-footer text-muted">%s</div>
    </div>
    ',
    data$title,
    data$explain_url,
    data$explain_url,
    data$img,
    data$alt,
    data$alt
  )
  
  knitr::asis_output(html_content)
} else {
  print(paste("Error: Data file not found at", data_path))
}
```

<script>
// Immediately unregister any service workers to fix the "cannot open connection" Shinylive error
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
  navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations().then(function(registrations) {
    for(let registration of registrations) {
      console.log('Unregistering Service Worker:', registration);
      registration.unregister();
    }
  });
}
</script>
